Jimmy Corsetti joins the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 1742. Corsetti's Bright Insight channel turned him into the internet's history hunter, arguing for lost chapters of the human past. His specialty is Atlantis and the sites he says the experts misread.

He walks Rogan through the evidence he rates highest, from the Sahara's Richat Structure to drowned coasts and old maps. Rogan asks how a YouTube researcher checks himself without a university behind him. The episode is a full hearing for the amateur's case, in a studio that has done more than any other to amplify it.
